overview: Compute and power dominated the day: Social Capital says H100 rental prices are up 45% since December, and Chamath and Musk both point to power and data-center buildout as the bottleneck. On the technical side, Jon Barron reported a softmax/cross-entropy bug affecting existing implementations, and a post says Anthropic is advising fewer subagents. For markets, Ackman is reportedly calling Fannie and Freddie 10x candidates while a mortgage-cost executive order was reported; most other posts were US and Israeli politics.

top_items.title: chamath - Social Capital says renting an Nvidia H100 costs 45% more than in December; Chamath says power is the binding constraint
zhihanyang_ - Jon Barron reports subtle bugs in all softmax/cross-entropy implementations; Yang says they mainly bite on low-entropy targets
chamath - Post says Anthropic now advises fewer subagents; one client ran about 2x faster after switching to a single agent loop
elonmusk - Musk says Ukraine used Starlink for offensive drone strikes against its terms and that the 'loophole was closed last week'
BillAckman - Reposted post says Ackman told CNBC that Fannie Mae (FNMA) and Freddie Mac could still rise 10x
burrytracker - Shares Unusual Whales report, citing CNBC, that Trump signed an executive order aimed at cutting mortgage costs
MatthewBerman - Tests DeepSeek 4.1 Flash running locally on a DGX Station and calls the result 'decent'
